answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the prism count is verified against the jetty text itself, the orchard audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 79 aliases thus means producing 79 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 8 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
